(nga )༄༅/ /spyan ras gzigs tshem bu lugs kyi smar khrid ngag 'don nyung ngu don tshang zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje'i dngos/ /

tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// spyan ras gzigs tshem bu lugs kyi smar khrid ngag 'don nyung ngu don tshang zhes bya ba bzhugs so// sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs rje'i dngos// bla ma spyan ras gzigs phyag 'tshal// de yi smar khrid tshem bu lugs// nyung ngu rin chen don 'dus bri// de la sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po sngon 'gro la bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa/ ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa gnyis las/ dang po la skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams// dpal ldan bla ma rdzogs sangs rgyas// chos dang dge 'dun thams cad la// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// zhes skyabs 'gro ci nus dang*/ gzhan don sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir// thugs rje chen po bsgom par bgyi// zhes sems bskyed lan gsum/ gnyis pa ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad zla la// rdo rje sems dpa' rdor dril 'dzin// dkar gsal zhi 'dzum rgyan gyis brgyan// rol pa'i stabs bzhugs thugs kar hūm̐// de yi 'od kyis rgyal rnams kyi// ye shes bdud rtsi spyan drangs thim// hūm̐ las ye shes bdud rtsi bab// lus

bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi/ gang sdig sgrib nyes ltung sbyang*// zhes dang*/ oṃ badzra sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badzra sa twa twe no pa tiṣṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣyo me bha wa/ a nu rakto me bha wa/ su po ṣyo me bha wa/ sarba siddhi mme pra yatstsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsittaṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badzra mā me muñtsa/ badzrī bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ zhes yi ge brgya pa dang*/ oṃ badzra sa twa hūm̐ zhes pa'i snying po'ang ci nus bzlas mthar/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsung thugs// rdo rje'i dam tshig nyams pa rnams// khyed la mthol bshags tshangs par stsol// rdor sems 'od zhu rang la thim// zhes bsams la de'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag go /gsum pa ni/ nam mkhar seng khri gdan nyi zla padma gsum steng*// rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang*// sngon po rdo rje dril bu bsnol// zhi ba'i rgyan rdzogs skyil krung bzhugs// thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyis// rang bzhin gnas nas skyabs yul ni// dpag med badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥdabyer med thim// skyabs gnas kun 'dus bdag nyid gyur// gang gi drin gyis sogs shlau ka gcig dang*/ spro na 'di'i brgyud 'debs kyis gsol ba gdab pa'i mthar/ maṇḍal 'bul na'ang skabs 'dir 'bul/ bla ma sangs rgyas rin po cher// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis rlobs// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs byin rlabs// 'bru gsum byung ba rang la thim// dbang thob dri ma ma lus dag /bla ma rang rgyud ro gcig 'dres// zhes brjod la/ de'i ngang la sems kyi mtshan nyid gsal ba/ rang bzhin stong pa/ ngo bo zung 'jug gsum dbyer mi phyed pa bla ma sku bzhi'i bdag nyid can gyi rang zhal mthong ba na mnyam par gzhag go /gnyis pa ni/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/

zhes pas chos rnams thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bskyed rim bsgom pa/ rdzogs rim bsgom pa/ bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor dang gsum las/ dang po la mngon byang lnga las lha bskyed pa/ 'od zer gyi spro bsdu bya ba'o// dang po ni/ snying dbus stong par gyur pa'i ngang*// paṃ las sna tshogs padma dang*// a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng*// rang sems hrīḥyig dkar po las// 'od 'phros ma dag lus sbyangs nas// 'od zer hrīḥdang bcas pa ni// pad dkar 'dab ma brgyad par gyur// de yang zhu ba las byung ba'i// rang nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs// sku mdog dkar po ston zla 'dra// zhal ras zhi zhing 'dzum bag can// phyag bzhi gnyis ni thal mo sbyar// gnyis ni phreng ba padmas mtshan// dar dang rin chen du mas brgyan// chu skyes zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// gnyis pa ni/ snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas// phyi snod 'jig rten gzhal yas khang*// yang 'od 'phros/ nang bcud sems can lha ru byas// yang 'od 'phros/ yi dam rgyal ba sras dang bcas// ma lus spyan drangs rang la bstim// slar yang 'od 'phros/ bla ma spyan drangs nas// bla mas bum pa'i chu dbang bskur// sgo gsum dri ma dag byas nas// 'od dpag med pas spyi bor brgyan// de la rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams// spyan drangs nas ni dbyer med thim// e ma lha sku snang stong 'di// rmi lam sgyu ma'i ngang du bzhag /ces pa de'i ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par gzhag pa ni bskyed pa'i rim pa'o// gnyis pa rdzogs rim rdo rje'i bzlas pa shes na 'dir bsgom mo// gsum pa bzlas pa bya ba ni/ snying gar zla ba'i steng du hrīḥ/ yig drug sngags kyis bskor bar bsam// bdag dang 'gro drug lhar gsal bas// grag stong sngags kyi bzlas pa bya// zhes bsam zhing*/

oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ zhes pa ci nus bzlas mthar/ thal mo sbyar la/ bla ma 'od dpag med pa dang*// yi dam thugs rje chen po yis// 'di phyi bar do thams cad du// thugs rjes dgongs la dngos grub stsol// zhes pas 'dod don gsol ba gdab bo// gsum pa rjes ni/ dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan rnams// tshe ring nad med dam chos ldan// mthar thug spyan ras gzigs thob nas// ma gyur 'gro ba'i don byed shog /ces pas dge ba bsngos la rjes thob zas gos stan rnams 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas rang kun 'dus rnam gnyis su gsal bas longs spyad pa dang*/ gnyid dang 'pho ba bar do'i rnal 'byor rnams gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar dang sku gsung thugs kyi 'khyer so gsum dang nam yang ma bral bar nyams su blangs pas/ tshe 'di'am/ bar do'am/ skye ba brgyud du 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thams cad dang bral te rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i zhal gyi lung*// grub dbang thugs bcud gdams pa'i mchog /mkhas grub du ma'i gshegs shul 'di// legs par thos de bla ma'i drin// bzhin snod chung ngu yin yang bla// skyes bu'i bzhin ras yongs gsal bzhin// nyung ngu don tshang bris pa yin// dge bas 'gro la phan gyur cig /ces pa spyan ras gzigs tshem bu lugs kyi smar khrid ngag 'don nyung ngu don tshang zhes bya ba 'di ni nye bar gnas pa kun dga' bsam gtan sogs don gnyer rnams kyi ngor/ chos rje bla ma dam pa sogs kyi khrid yig tshad ldan dang mthun par blo dman rnams kyis nyams su blang bde bar bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis sa dkar bsam 'grub gling du bris pa dge bar gyur cig 'gro ba thams cad la'o// // ༄༅// thugs rje chen po tshem bu lugs kyi 'pho ba'i gdams pa bde ldan 'dren pa'i theg pa zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// phun tshogs bde ldan zhing gi yon tan gyi// bkod pa yongs bzung 'gro kun der 'dren pa'i// bla ma bcom ldan 'od dpag med mgon gyis// zab lam gdams pa 'dri la gnang ba stsol// 'dir thugs rje chen po tshem bu lugs kyi gdams pa las/

zab lam 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor nyams su bstar ba la sbyang ba dang*/ las la sbyar ba gnyis las dang po ni/ sgrub thabs dang 'brel ba'am/ ma 'brel na snying thag pa nas skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed byas/ de nas/ rang lus thugs rje chen por gsal// lte ba'i 'og nas spyi gtsug bar// dbu ma 'od kyi sbu gu'i nang*// mar snar chos 'byung sngon po'i steng*// rang sems thig le ser rdog tsam// dkar sngo dmar 'od 'phro ba dang*// snying gar yi dam spyan ras gzigs// mtheb sor tsam zhig gsal yang gdab// spyi bor bla ma 'od dpag med// byams stabs kyis bzhugs tshangs bug haṃ// rgya mthongs lta bur phye bar mdzad// de la gsol ba 'di ltar btab// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad 'dus pa'i dngos// skyabs mchog bla ma rnams dang dbyer med pa'i// 'dren pa 'od dpag med la gsol ba 'debs// tshe 'di blo yis thongs par byin gyis rlobs// dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// zab lam 'pho ba 'byong bar byin gyis rlobs// 'phyugs med mkha' spyod 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// de ltar gsol btab rang sems kyi// thig le myur du yar byon nas// snying ga'i yi dam lha la thim// yi dam tshangs pa'i sgo nas byon// bla ma'i thugs kar sib kyis thim// bla ma yi dam rang sems gsum// ro gcig 'dren pa'i ngang du bzhag /hig slar yang yi dam snying gar byon// thig le nyid kyang rang gnas bab// ka de lta bu'i ngang nas yar 'pho ba dang mar 'bebs pa'i dmigs pa dang bcas te hig ka lan mang du bya/ thun bsdu ba na/ bla ma 'od zhu yi dam thim// de yang 'chi med bdud rtsir zhu// lus kun khyab pas 'chi med thob// tshangs bug haṃ gi yi ges bkag /ces bsams la rlung bum pa can bzung bas tshe sgrub tu'ang 'gyur ro// gnyis pa ni gzhan thams cad snga ma ji lta ba bzhin las/ khyad par ni ro gcig 'dren pa'i ngang du bzhag

/ces pa'i rjes su/ hig ka zhes brjod cing yar 'pho ba'i dmigs pa kho na las/ mar 'bebs pa'i dmigs pa mi bya bar bzhag de lta bu dbugs kyi rgyu ba ma chad pa'i bar la byas pas bar do med par mkha' la spyod pa'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba ni nges pa nyid do// ye shes lus phra dgyes pa'i zhal gyi lung*// mkhas grub tshogs rab gshegs pa'i lam po che// nyung gsal bris pa'i dge bas sems can kun// bde ldan 'dren pa'i theg pa mchog gyur cig /ces thugs rje chen po tshem bu lugs kyi 'pho ba'i gdams pa bde ldan 'dren pa'i theg pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dpon rgan a skyabs kyis bskul ngor/ khrid gzhung gi snying po nyams su bstar bde bar bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis sde dge lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa dge'o// sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༄༅// thugs rje chen po tshem bu lugs kyi sgrub thabs nyung 'dus zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// na mo gu ru bhyaḥ bla ma mchog dang dbyer med pa'i// phyag na padma la btud de// tshem bu lugs kyi spyan ras gzigs// sgrub thabs snying po nyung 'dus 'dri// 'dir grub chen gnyen tshem bu pa'i lugs kyi thugs rje chen po bsgom pa la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang por skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ bla ma rnams dang dkon mchog gsum// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// gzhan don sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir// thugs rje chen po bsgom par bgyi// zhes lan gsum/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum las/ dang po bskyed rim lha bskyed pa ni/ oṃ sarba bhā wa shuddhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ snying dbus stong par gyur pa'i ngang*// padma zla ba'i gdan steng du// rang sems hrīḥyig dkar po las// 'od 'phros ma dag lus sbyangs nas// 'od zer hrīḥdang bcas pa ni// pad dkar 'dab ma brgyad par gyur// de yang 'od kyi gong bur zhu// de las rang nyid spyan ras gzigs// sku mdog dkar po ston zla 'dra// zhal ras zhi zhing 'dzum bag ldan// phyag bzhi'i gnyis ni thal mo sbyar// gnyis ni phreng ba padma bsnams// dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung bzhugs// snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas// phyi snod 'jig rten gzhal yas khang*// nang bcud sems can lha ru byas// yi dam rgyal ba sras dang bcas// ma lus spyan drangs rang la thim// slar yang bla ma spyan drangs nas// bla mas bum pa'i chu dbang bskur// sgo gsum sgrib pa dag byas nas// 'od dpag med pas spyi bor brgyan// de la rtsa ba'i bla ma dang*// brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad thim// e ma lha sku snang stong ni// rmi lam sgyu ma'i ngang du bzhag

/ces pa bskyed rim gyi lha sku snang stong zung 'jug gi ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par gzhag go /gnyis pa rdzogs rim ni rdo rje'i bzlas pa man ngag bzhin nyams su blangs nas de las skyes pa'i ye shes phyag rgya chen po'i ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par gzhag go /gsum pa bzlas pa bya ba ni/ snying gar zla ba'i steng du hrīḥ /yig drug sngags kyis bskor bar gsal// bdag dang 'gro drug lhar gsal bas// grag stong sngags kyi bzlas pa bya// oṃ ma ṇi padme hūm̐/ ci nus bzlas mthar/ bla ma 'od dpag med pa dang*// yi dam thugs rje chen po yis// 'di phyi bar do thams cad du// thugs rjes dgongs la dngos grub stsol// zhes 'dod don gsol ba btab la/ gsum pa rjes ni/ dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan kun// tshogs gnyis rdzogs shing sgrib gnyis sbyangs// mthar thug spyan ras gzigs grub nas// ma gyur 'gro ba'i don byed shog /ces pas dge ba bsngos la/ spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor drug dang rnam pa thams cad du sku gsung thugs kyi 'khyer so gsum dang ma bral bar byas na dal 'byor la snying po blangs par 'gyur ba ni nges pa'o// gru 'dzin bgrod pa'i sgrub thabs kyi// nor bu'i them skas bgyis pa yi// dge bas 'phags mchog dgyes pa'i zhal// sems can kun gyis mthong gyur cig /ces pa'i tshem bu lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs nyung 'dus 'di'ang don gnyer gyi ngor bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral bris so// sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// smar khrid tshem bu lugs kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs bzhugs// ༄༅// rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang dbang rnal 'byor ma// grub dang tshem bu pa dang spyi lhas pa/ byang chub 'od/ brag dmar ba/ byang chub tshul khrims bsod nams dgon gsar ba/ snying po la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// jo nang kun

thugs rje brtson 'grus/ spangs rgyal ba ye shes pa// gzhon nu seng ge bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang*// kun dga' theg chen/ bkra shis thugs sras dpal ldan legs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// bdag chen blo gros rgyal mtshan rdo ring pa// nam mkha'i mtshan can tshar chen chos kyi rje// mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bsod nams chos 'phel la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// ngag dbang chos grags rgyal rtse bsod nams mtshan// sangs rgyas dpal bzang sangs rgyas phun tshogs zhabs// kun dga' bstan 'dzin buddha shrī bha drar// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// skyabs kun 'dus pa'i bdag nyid dngos brgyud kyi// bla ma rnams dang yi dam spyan ras gzigs// mkha' 'gro chos srung nor lhar bcas pa la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// sngon 'gro thun mong khyad par rnal 'byor gyis// tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i pha rol phyin pa dang*// dngos gzhi bskyed dang rdzogs pa phyag rgya che// zung 'jug bsgoms pas sku bzhi thob par shog /gsang sngags rgyal po yi ge drug pa'i sgra// skye 'gag bral ba brag ca'i bzlas brjod kyis// yi dam zhi khro'i rnam rol grangs med kyi// zhal mthong dngos grub rnam gnyis 'grub par shog /rjes thob snang grag rig par cir snang dngos// lha sngags ye shes 'khor lor rnam par dag /zas gos gnyid dang bar do'i 'khrul snang rnams// bden med sgyu ma'i lam du long bar shog /mdor na kun 'dus bdag nyid bla ma lhas// rjes su bzung nas po ta la ri dang*// bde ba can sogs dag pa'i zhing bgrod cing*// 'gro ba rgya mtsho smin pa byed par shog /ces thugs rje chen po'i smar khrid tshem bu lugs kyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs 'di ni nyung ngu la dga' ba rnams kyi ngor bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis bris pa'o// maṅga laṃ//

// ༄༅// grub chen tshem bu pa'i lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i bsnyen pa bya tshul gyi yi ge bzhugs so// ༄༅// bde gshegs yongs kyi thugs kyi 'gro ba la// rjes su chags gzugs byang chub sems dpa'i tshul// mgon po pad dkar 'chang la thal sbyar nas// de nyid bsnyen tshul yi ge'i lam nas gleng*// de'ang 'dir grub chen tshem bu pa'i lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i bsnyen pa bya ba la/ dbang dang byin rlabs sogs legs par mnos pa'i gang zag gis/ gnas dben par spyan ras gzigs kyi sku rten bshams pa'i mdun gyi stegs bu la sogs par zlum gtor gnyis/ chu gnyis nyer spyod bcas dang*/ logs shig tu nub dang por mkho ba'i cha gsum mam mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gang mos kyi gtor ma'ang bsham mo// de nas sgrub pa po stan la 'khod de/ thog mar cha gsum gtor ma spyi ltar btang la bgegs gtor phyi rol du dor/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags bzla zhing dril bu drag tu gsil/ gu gul gyis bdugs la mtshams bcad/ yang na nā ro mkha' spyod cho ga'i sngon 'gro ltar mkha' 'gro spyi gtor btang kyang chog ste/ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang ba ma gtogs gtor ma byin rlabs nas yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar dang*/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi sogs nas/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir/ sa'i phyogs 'dir bsgom bzlas kyi rnal 'byor nyams su blang ba 'tshal na/ srung ma'i dbang po khyed rnams kyis bsgom bzlas kyi rnal 'byor mthar ma phyin bar gyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ de nas kyang byang chub ma thob bar gyi bar chad thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i stong grogs mdzod cig ces dang*/ lag pa g.yas rdo rje dang bcas sa la reg ste/ muḥgang dag nag po'i phyogs sogs nas song shig ces pa'i bar dang*/ sumbha ni sogs kyi drag sngags brjod pas mtshams bcad do// de nas mchod pa rnams la dmigs te/

oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba sogs nas/ shabda swā hā/ dharma ra ṇi lan gsum brjod pa'i bar spyi ltar byin dbab/ dngos gzhi la bdag bskyed rje dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i tshigs bcad ma dang sbyar ba'am/ dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa'i khrid yig snying po gsal ba dang*/ kho bos byas pa'i smar khrid kyi ngag 'don nyung ngu don tshang sogs gang yang rung ste/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ bskyed rim rdzogs rim/ zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po'i rnal 'byor rnams khrid gzhung ltar nyams su blangs nas/ bsnyen pa'i dngos gzhi yi ge drug pa'i gsang sngags ci nus su bzla/ thun gyi mthar 'dod don gsol ba gdab pa yan grub nas/ dge ba bsngo ba'i gong der gtor ma bsngo ste/ de'ang gtor ma chab kyis bran la/ bsang sbyangs sngar bzhin dang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma 'dod dgu 'byung ba ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gtor mgron bskyed pa ni/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar paṃ las padma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥyig dkar po/ de yongs su gyur pa las 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas shel dkar gyi phreng ba dang*/ g.yon 'og mas padma dkar po 'dzin pa/ zhal 'dzum zhing rab tu zhi ba/ spyan gnyis sems dpa'i lta stangs kyis gzigs pa/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog can/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ zhabs rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/

mgrin par āḥ thugs ka'i stod du hūm̐/ dbus su hrīḥ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor bar oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas bstim/ slar yang hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa sngar bzhin spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis oṃ badzrī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ gtor mgron bsdu na skad cig gis spyan drangs pas kyang btub/ de nas ljags rdo rje'i 'od kyi sbu gus gtor ma'i bcud drangs par bsams la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ ārya a wa lo ke shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa lan gsum mam bdun gyis 'bul/ mtshan sngags de nyid sngon 'gro'i arghaṃ la sogs pas mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar// zhes sogs kyis bstod la/ jo bo thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la byams pa dang snying rje byang chub sems bcos ma ma yin pa rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du rje btsun spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol ba gdab bo// mkha' 'gro spyi gtor oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥha ho hrīḥlan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ phaiṃ badzra a ra li hoḥ dzaḥhūm̐ sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar gtor chog ltar bya/ de ltar mi shes na/ gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas/ lag pa g.yas 'dod pa'i rgyal po'i phyag rgya dang*/

oṃ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra ā karṣa ya dzaḥzhes pas bkug la sngags de la oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis bsngos/ 'jig rten pa yi 'byung po rnams// mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnams la// chos don bden pa la gnas nas// zhi zhing dul ba'i sems su mdzod// bdag kyang byang chub ma thob bar// gegs med bar chad med pa dang*// dam tshig gnas la gnas mdzod la// byang chub thob pa'i grogs kyang mdzod// ces dang*/ mtheb srin kyi se gol dang*/ lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra gatstsha/ zhes pa'i 'jig rten pa'i mgron gshegs/ 'jig rten las 'das pa la/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ rten yod na/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang sogs kyis brtan bzhugs bya/ med na/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can sogs dang*/ oṃ badzra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim par bsams la/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ sogs kyis gnas gsum bsrungs nas/ dge ba 'di yis sogs kyis bsngo ba smon lam gang shes byas la/ thun mtshams thams cad du lus ngag yid gsum lha'i sku gsung thugs kyi 'khyer so gsum dang ma bral ba'i sgo nas spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la 'jug go /de lta bu'i rim pas bsnyen pa'i tshad ni 'bum phrag bco brgyad dam drug cu sogs gsungs kyang nyung mtha' zla ba gcig tu mdzad pa mthong zhing mang mtha' la ni tshad la ma ltos par zhal mthong ba la sogs pa'i bar ro// bsil ldan 'gro la lhag pa'i lha gzhan las// thugs rje che myur phyag na padma yi// bsnyen thabs bris pa'i dge bas bdag gzhan rnams// 'phags mchog byang chub spyod rjes slob par shog /ces grub chen tshem bu pa'i lugs kyi thugs rje chen po'i bsnyen pa bya tshul gyi yi ge 'di ni dge slong sangs rgyas seng ge'i ngor/ bande tshul khrims rin chen gyis lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa sarba maṅga la bhā wa tu//

// ༄༅// na mo gu ra we/ 'jam dpal gzhon nu tshe rabs lhar bsnyen pa// bdag la gzhung mang 'dzin dang 'chad rtsod rtsom// shes bya bcu phrag rig pa'i gzhung rnams la// bsnyengs bral blo dang ngag gi dngos grub stsol// zhes lhag pa'i lha 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'dod gsol sbrang rtsi'i mgrin rnga zhes bya ba 'di ni/ bande tshul khrims rin chen rang gis sug bris su byas pa'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
